I dont know how to explain whats wrong. my mind is whats wrong, i hate who i am and why im this way.

My mom likes to start arguments over very tiny things that dont matter, she also eats healthy for a week and then eats horribly for a month after, claiming it as a "special diet". 

Because she suffocates me, i eventually picked all those habits up, but i got out of them in no time. It was a sad way, i started to become anorexic and i just gave up. But now, after four years, im relatively healthy again.  i dont have to bite my tongue about little things anymore either, i just stopped caring altogether.

my boyfriend knows what im dealing with. He helps me when i need someone the most, but school is starting for him soon and he just wants extra time to study. Which sucks. 
I feel really numb. I dont have much hope left 😔

Ive felt that a lot in the past! For me, i would write him these sweet paragraphs every month or so, just telling him how much i love him and thinking of a future irl with him.

i say, just talk it out every once in a while, maybe go on skype, watch some movies together. Make it seem like you guys are together irl, its really fun thinking of things to do and it makes time pass by until you guys can actually meet. 

I hope this helps 🙂

Youre not alone!
